headline: No high-signal developments today; one actionable GEO content framework worth testing

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: WordPress 7.0.3 patches high-severity XSS vulnerability | WordPress 7.0.3修复高危XSS漏洞
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: XSS漏洞可被利用注入恶意脚本，影响搜索可见性与用户信任；未及时修补可能导致排名下降或安全警告。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Official WordPress security release covered by Search Engine Journal
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Search Engine Journal reported on WordPress security release 7.0.3, which fixes a high-severity XSS vulnerability. The article references Martinibuster as a source. No technical details of the exploit mechanism or affected version scope were provided in the candidate text.

sources.name: Search Engine Journal
sources.excerpt: WordPress Security Release 7.0.3 Fixes High Severity XSS Vulnerability via @sejournal, @martinibuster. WordPress securit
sources.author: Search Engine Journal

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Aleyda Solís publishes Content Prioritization Framework for AI Search era | Aleyda发布AI搜索时代内容优先级框架
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: AI搜索时代，并非所有内容都值得同等投入；需要系统性地将资源重新分配到agentic traffic仍依赖的页面类型上。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence: Expert analysis with downloadable worksheet from established international SEO practitioner
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Aleyda Solís, a widely-cited international SEO consultant, released a framework and worksheet for categorizing content types by their resilience in an AI search environment. The framework appears designed to help teams audit existing content and prioritize creation based on which formats are likely to continue driving value as AI Overviews and agentic search reduce traditional CTR. No controlled experiment or traffic data is included; the value lies in the operational structure for team decision-making.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 下载工作表，在20-50个URL的样本上运行框架，对比agentic traffic前后的表现
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 选取20-50个URL，按框架分为'高AI风险/低AI风险'两类，追踪90天内来自AI Overviews和直接搜索的impressions与CTR变化
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: 低AI风险类别的impressions和CTR下降幅度显著小于高AI风险类别（>15%差距）
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 中等：需内容审计+标签+90天追踪；风险低，主要是时间成本

sources.excerpt: Content Prioritization in an AI Search Era: A Framework + Worksheet 👇 What type of content is still worth creating when
sources.author: aleyda

Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_happened: Glenn Gabe observes ChatGPT grounding quality declining, flags potential Meta web index | Glenn Gabe观察到ChatGPT grounding质量下滑，提及Meta可能构建网页索引
Unconfirmed Watchlist.why_it_matters: 若ChatGPT grounding持续退化，GEO策略需调整；Meta入局搜索索引将改变AI搜索竞争格局与流量分配。
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence: Practitioner observation from data-focused SEO analyst with history of accurate algorithm tracking
Unconfirmed Watchlist.evidence_detail: Glenn Gabe, who regularly tracks search volatility and AI search developments, posted two observations: that ChatGPT's grounding (ability to accurately cite and use web content) is becoming 'sketchy,' and separately that Meta may be building a web index. Neither claim includes methodology, sample size, or official confirmation. The grounding observation aligns with broader practitioner chatter but lacks quantitative backing.
Unconfirmed Watchlist.what_to_do: 监控ChatGPT引用自己品牌的准确性；关注Meta搜索相关专利或招聘

sources.excerpt: Is another web index on its way? Possibly... and this time it's from Meta. ChatGPT grounding is already getting sketchy.
